content.text:
The pricing page is fixed. The "Most popular" ribbon on the Pro plan was being hidden behind the card.

The cause was a `z-index: -1` on `.plan-ribbon` in `site/css/pages.css`. It pushed the ribbon behind the card's white background, so only a sliver poked out above the card. I removed that line.

The pricing screenshots now match the approved ones at desktop and phone size. The functional tests also pass, 28 in total across both suites.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
